tests.name: Test 1.1 - Specific date with availability
tests.purpose: Confirm a typed specific date returns direct availability for that date before any widget-first redirection.

rows.action: Open the chat surface for a tenant with scheduling enabled.
rows.what_is_tested: Baseline setup for typed-date availability checks.
rows.comment: I've asked for available slots on 9 APR 2026. System returned next 3 days.
rows.reference_files:
review once don't waist tokens on every test if the reference file is the same.
trace_2026-03-31_12-12-35_milena_dental_55d022eb-f823-4a8b-a868-4fcd079ea058.txt

rows.action: Ask for availability on a concrete date that has available slots.
rows.comment:
When typed 09.04.2026 the system returned the time slots, however it did not return the time slot widget, rendered the dates in a list.
Expected is to have the clickable dates. 

Also the system prompts a message 
За да проверам слободни термини на 9 април 2026, ве молам кажете ми ги вашите име, телефон и е-маил.

It should offer a message from the LLM to get the context and to inform the user something along the lines Ова се слободни термини за DD MonthWord. YYYY
